mainEntity.name: How do I know if the damage to my framing is severe enough for professional repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should seek professional assessment if you notice significant indicators of structural problems, such as widespread wood rot, persistent sagging in floors or ceilings, visibly bowed or leaning walls, or doors and windows that no longer close properly. While minor cosmetic issues can be addressed with simple fixes, structural damage to framing impacts the safety and stability of your entire building. A professional inspection by Hometelligent Inc. can accurately determine the severity and recommend the appropriate course of action, ensuring your property remains sound.
acceptedAnswer.description: If you observe widespread wood rot, sagging floors, bowed walls, or improperly closing doors/windows, professional framing repair is likely needed. A professional assessment can determine the damage's severity.
